reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Frames design-stack as a reusable visual practice with a defined input-to-output path, explicit boundaries, and a reviewable acceptance surface.
neutralIntentExamples: apply design-stack to a matching visual brief
evaluate design-stack against its rendering, asset, and interaction constraints
inputs: visual brief and target framework or medium
available assets, references, and runtime constraints
operations: compose the rule with assets and implementation primitives
inspect responsive, accessible, and degraded states
failureBehavior: defer when the brief or required resource is absent
mark provider- or framework-specific steps as conditional
usefulInvariants: visual intent remains distinct from implementation detail
human or rendered review closes the loop
materialRisks: style convergence when tokens are not re-authored
runtime behavior may differ from the source context

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Defines a causal field bundle for shared procedural geometry and material channels, with named diagnostics and scale-aware filtering.
neutralIntentExamples: design shared scalar and vector fields for a procedural surface
derive material channels from stable geometric causes
inputs: coordinate system and perceptual scale bands
surface channels, mesh density, and camera range
operations: declare macro, meso, and derived fields
reuse causes across color, roughness, normals, displacement, and scattering
expose field diagnostics and filter high frequencies
outputs: coherent channel bundle with debug views
failureBehavior: stop when coordinates, scale, or causal ownership are undefined
retain a lower-fidelity result when mesh or camera cannot represent the requested detail
exclusions: hiding the look in one opaque expression
usefulInvariants: perceptual parameter names map to visible roles
materialRisks: overly broad masks creating bland regions

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Provides a state-driven method with explicit phase ownership, continuity or timing constraints, and a verification boundary.
neutralIntentExamples: design threejs-procedural-animation behavior from authored phases and visible intent
review threejs-procedural-animation output for timing, continuity, and degradation boundaries
inputs: visual brief, target medium, and timing or interaction state
assets, viewport or frame geometry, and runtime budget
operations: map semantic states to transforms, effects, or scene beats
preserve directional and temporal continuity across boundaries
measure the result at representative sizes and reduced-motion conditions
outputs: boundary checklist with fallback and verification evidence
failureBehavior: stop or downgrade when timing, asset readiness, or render support is missing
surface runtime, accessibility, and performance failures instead of self-certifying
exclusions: assuming a still frame proves temporal correctness
treating a named effect as a complete implementation
usefulInvariants: motion has an owner and a reason
timing is measured in elapsed time or explicit frames
materialRisks: jank and overdraw under real content
template or provider assumptions can leak into unrelated frameworks

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Supplies a 3d asset or scene pattern whose visual character depends on explicit resources, coordinate ownership, and a runtime quality or validation boundary.
neutralIntentExamples: build a threejs-skill-router visual with its controlling parameters exposed
adapt threejs-skill-router across a bounded quality tier and runtime fallback
inputs: visual target, camera or viewport, and supported rendering path
textures, geometry, shader inputs, assets, and frame budget
operations: separate authored geometry, material, temporal, and post effects
bind resources and lifecycle cleanup explicitly
compare baseline, degraded mode, and representative runtime views
outputs: resource and performance checklist with fallback
failureBehavior: fail closed when required assets, context, or shader capabilities are unavailable
keep the no-post or low-fidelity baseline legible
exclusions: equating a screenshot with a validated system
usefulInvariants: quality tier changes mechanism or resolution deliberately

materialRisks: context loss, shader portability, and mobile GPU limits
